title: Agentic AI discovers verifier-checked fault-tolerant quantum circuits
summary: An LLM-guided evolutionary search produced circuits for encoded-state preparation, logical gates and code switching across quantum error-correction codes. An exhaustive verifier checked the stated circuit operations and fault-tolerance criteria. The results are computational constructions; no quantum-hardware demonstration is reported.
ai_technology: FunSearch-style LLM-guided evolutionary search with exhaustive circuit verification
organization: Max Planck Institute for the Science of Light, Erlangen, Germany

evidence.tested: The search generated encoded-state, logical-gate and code-switching circuits; the paper reports exhaustive verification of their target operations and fault-tolerance conditions, including constructions for several codes.
evidence.unknown: The constructions are theoretical and verifier-checked; the paper reports no hardware implementation.
evidence.ai_role: An LLM proposes and evolves circuit programs; an exhaustive verifier checks their target operation and modeled fault tolerance.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
